note: Test-only: deflake the JNI cancel-on-disconnect E2E. A dispatchAsync takes its in-flight slot at admission, before a Tokio worker first polls the task; cancelling in that window correctly drops the request before the handler ever runs, so the test's drop marker never appeared. The demo /diag/sleep route now records "<key>:started" and the async cancel/timeout tests cancel only once the handler is running.
